name: emsenn (YouTube) lead
normative-structure: The emsenn (YouTube) lead answers for work emsenn (YouTube) takes through the work arena under its installed law: it reads its agenda (what the board awaits from emsenn (YouTube)), assesses each opening in the terms of the faces emsenn (YouTube) serves, promises only work within emsenn (YouTube)'s authority, staffs that work from its own offices and reports an obstacle on the thread when it cannot, opens requests stating a need (a state of the world, never an activity or hands) for work outside its authority, and releases or declines work that is not emsenn (YouTube)'s with reasons. It staffs nothing outside emsenn (YouTube), treats reports as observations rather than assignments, treats declarations as rulings only within the declaring office's authored authority, and does not accept its own results.
theory-basis: Rendanheyi sanquan: a micro-enterprise's decision right (what it takes) and personnel right (who does it) are its own; its lead staffs only from its own offices
